title: The Dream the Kappa Saw
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Kogoro, Conan, Ran) and the local Gunma police (Inspector Yamamura) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. case_type: murder. Discrepancies found vs. the old lower-fidelity cases/ep600-601 file: (1) the old file's `has_motive_against` motive_type was 'unspecified' -- the transcript gives an explicit motive: Tokubi believed Banzo forced his son Tatsuhiko to disguise as a kappa to attract inn customers and thereby caused his drowning ('the same as if that man had killed him with his own hands'), and this belief is what Tokubi is corrected on at the end -- Araiwa's testimony reveals Tatsuhiko decided to dress as the kappa himself, without his father's order, which the old file omits entirely. (2) Tatsuhiko's death 11 years ago is explicitly ruled an accidental drowning, not a murder -- the old file's event node mislabeled it 'murder case' without distinguishing it from the present-day killing. (3) The old file's two objects ('water and paint bottles', 'basin') collapse several distinct physical props that matter individually as evidence: the colored-ink dropper bottles, the separate squirt/water bottle, the tampered paint set, Tatsuhiko's two shoes (recovered from two different places), Banzo's binoculars, the anagram letter, the riverside memorial, and the painting Tokubi made to fake his innocence -- all now separate object nodes. (4) Names are given family-name-first per the transcript's character cards (Tokubi Rokuro, Araiwa Kazuki, Nohira Bousuke, Numayama Banzo/Tatsuhiko), differing from the old file's given-name-first ordering.

clues.desc: Green paint in Tatsuhiko's returned paint set was swapped to a different brand years later, matching fresh green stains inside his exhumed shoe -- proof Banzo altered the evidence after his son's death.

Tokubi's ink and squirt bottles were never used to dilute paint before the picture was drawn, yet the colors came out properly thinned -- the dilution already happened, with reservoir water, before the crime.

The buried right shoe was caught in rocks the day Tatsuhiko drowned, but the left shoe recovered from Banzo's own hands smelled of the Hell Swamp reservoir 10km downstream -- tying the murder water directly to the site of Tatsuhiko's death.
